m: वैलाभ्य n. (fr. वि-लाभ) g. दृढादि (Kāś.)
वैलात्य n. (fr. विलात) g. दृढादि (v.l. वैलाभ्य).
वैल mf(ई)n. (fr. विल = बिल) relating or belonging to or living in a hole or pit, MW. (cf. बैल).
वैलकि m. a patr. g. तौल्वल्य्-आदि (Kāś.)

s: klI, (vilakzaRasya BAvaH । vilakzaRa + zyaY .) vilakzaRatvam । vilakzaRasya BAva ityarTe zRyapratyayena nizpannamidam । (yaTA, BAgavate । 10 । 55 । 29 । “avaDAryya SanErIzadvElakzaRyena yozitaH ॥” viBinnatvam । yaTA, manO kullUkaH । 1 । 85 । “tretAdizvapi yugApacArarUpeRa DarmmavElakzaRyam ॥”)
v: na॰ vilakzaRasya BAvaH zyaY । vilakzaRatve vESizwye
m: वैलक्षण्य n. (fr. वि-लक्षण) difference, disparity, diverseness (often ifc.; पूर्वोक्त-वैलक्षण्येन, in opposition to what was before stated), Rājat.; BhP.; Sāh. &c.
indeterminableness, indescribableness, Kāvyād., Sch.
strangeness, A.
a: वैलक्षण्यं — [विलक्षणस्य भावः ष्यञ्] 1 Strangeness. --2 Contrariety, opposition. --3 Difference, disparity.

v: na॰ vilakzasya BAvaH zyaY । 1 lajjAyAm amaraH 2 svaBAvavElakzaRye ca “vElakzyahetorgatimetadIyAm” nEza॰ ।
m: वैलक्ष्य n. (fr. वि-लक्ष; ifc. f(आ). ) absence of mark, W.
contrariety, reverse, W.
the reverse of what is usual or natural, unnaturalness, affectation (cf. स-वैलक्ष्यम्), W.
feeling of shame, embarrassment, Hariv.; Kāv. &c.
a: वैलक्ष्यं — [विलक्षस्य भावः ष्यञ्] 1 Embarrassment, confusion. --2 Unnaturalness, affectation; वैलक्ष्यस्मितं ‘a forced or affected smile’. --3 Shame. --4 Absence of any mark or characteristic. --5 Contrariety, inversion.

m: वैलक्ष्य—वत् mfn. abashed, embarrassed, Bālar.
वैल—स्थान n. a place like a hole, lurking-place, covert, RV.
a burying-place, MW.
वैल—स्थानक mfn. situated in a hole or lurking-place or covert, RV.
वैल—स्थानक n. a pit, MW.
वैल—स्थ see महा-वैल-स्थ.
वैलेपिक mfn. (fr. वि-लेपिका) g. महिष्य्-आदि.
वैलिङ्ग्य n. (fr. वि-लिङ्ग) absence of distinctive marks, ĀpŚr., Sch.
वैलोम्य n. (fr. वि-लोम) inversion, invertedness, Hcat.
contrariety, reverseness, opposition, MW.

s: klI, (vilvasyedam । aR .) vilvaPalam । ityamarawIkA ॥ vilvasambanDini, tri ॥ (yaTA, manO । 2 । 45 । “brAhmaRo vElvapAlASO kzattriyo vAwaKAdirO ॥”)
m: वैल्व See बैल्व.
